Hayai includes bundled JavaScript compatibility assets used only inside the
LNReader novel-plugin runtime:

- Cheerio (MIT): https://github.com/cheeriojs/cheerio
- protobuf.js (BSD-3-Clause): https://github.com/protobufjs/protobuf.js

The Kotlin/Java bridge was rebuilt for Hayai from Tsundoku's LNReader plugin
compatibility implementation, under Tsundoku's project license.
